title: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Sept. 8, 2026
total: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy’s deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Sept. 8, 2026, based on Navy and public data. In cases in which a CSG or ARG is conducting disaggregated operations, the chart reflects the location of the capital ship.

properties.name: In the Eastern Pacific
properties.said:
Aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) departed Saturday from San Diego, Calif., according to ship spotters .

Aircraft carrier USS Carl Vinson (CVN-70) returned Friday to San Diego, according to ship spotters .

Aircraft carrier USS Ronald Reagan (CVN-76) departed Thursday and returned Monday to Bremerton, Wash., according to ship spotters .

Amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) returned last Monday to San Diego, according to ship spotters .

properties.name: In the Western Atlantic
properties.said:
Aircraft carrier USS Dwight D. Eisenhower (CVN-69) returned Wednesday to Norfolk, Va., according to ship spotters .

Amphibious assault ship USS Kearsarge (LHD-3) returned Friday to Norfolk, according to ship spotters .

In addition to these major formations, not shown are others serving in submarines, individual surface ships, aircraft squadrons, SEALs, Special Purpose Marine Air-Ground Task Forces, Seabees, EOD Mobile Units and more throughout the globe.
